We have not yet informed <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> that we managed to pull out the <color=#FFFEC1>Crystal Skull</color>. It makes sense to re-think who exactly we should continue to cooperate with. Apparently <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color>, <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color>, and even <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> are all very interested in obtaining the recovered device... or artifact? Doesn’t matter. You choose who we work for next, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>.

Our scanners can't trace the <color=#FFFEC1>device</color>. It is likely located somewhere <color=#FFFEC1>deep underground</color>. Look for the <color=#FFFEC1>elevator</color> down. The geodesic is partially destroyed, so we will drop you right in the territory of the colony. I'm noticing some other signals, but they're not quasimorphs. I think these are some poorly armed <color=#FFFEC1>marauders</color>: former <color=#FFFEC1>Fresco</color> Sec officers, fugitive PMC mercs, pirates who broke into the Inner System, and so on. Shouldn't be any problems.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Retrieve AnCom [?] equipment.

Details: In the Oddibjord-3 colony, under a huge geodesic dome, there is a large laboratory complex that belonged to the Fresco Corporation. The goal is to find and evacuate the device that the guys from AnCom want to get. The colony has been destroyed as a result of continuous fighting on the surface of Venus since the appearance of Tezctlan. Now the quasimorphs loyal to him have captured the geodesic and will protect it no matter who appears there.

Additional Info: The Hexarchy, the union of six major corporations, has increased censorship. Of course, they deny the very existence of censorship. They say it is a concept from the distant past, when the nation states still existed. But we don’t believe that nonsense, do we, Boss? They control the largest routers in the System. The actions the hexarchs have taken to enhance their control over are associated with the appearance of Tezctlan on Venus. It will be easier for laborers and middle managers to work if they do not know about the monsters that prowl around them.

Because of our active participation in events, we know that the former assets of the destroyed concern Fresco on Venus became a battlefield between various forces and factions. The intensity of quasimorphic events on Venus is extremely high. And then our old customer AnCom crops up again. We were extremely lucky to find that PCPU at the Civil Resistance base. It seems that AnCom is hiding its success in advanced experiments with quasimorphosis carried out behind the backs of the other hexarchs.

HIS Unveiled, owned by AnCom, has been in the orbit of Venus for a while and is clearly engaged in a comprehensive study of its surface. And now AnCom has shared something with us.

As we thought, the accusation that the Civil Resistance has been fabricating quasimorphic activity on Venus is a lie. It looks like Tezctlan is trying to drag the quasimorphs of its bramfatura into our world. There are reports of successful phasing of huge structures. It’s a good opportunity to raise prices and start getting some real pleasure.

Greetings, mercenary. You might be interested in another short-term contract. The task is simple: retrieve our property. Again. You have shown that you are quite good at this. The mission target is the colony of <color=#FFFEC1>Oddibjord-3</color> on <color=#FFFEC1>Venus</color>. The data has already been uploaded to the Magnum. When you’re ready, get started. Over and out.

We confirm that this is a small task force of RealWare Sec fighters. Their corporate transponders are turned off, which means they are not covered by NCE. Such episodes among the hexarchs are rare, but this is a good chance to obtain information about the true balance of power in the System.

To facilitate the fulfillment of the contract we dropped two autonomous capsules with resources and promising prototypes from the Unveiled. A great opportunity for you to complete the mission, and for us to conduct field tests. The main goal of the contract does not change. We don't see anything you can't handle.

Attention, <color=#FFFEC1>HIS Unveiled</color> is speaking! Magnum, we have to inform you that the mission has been <color=#FFFEC1>canceled</color>. Unfortunately, contractual obligations will be revoked. We observe a large concentration of the enemy in the mission area. A decision was made to launch a tactical nuclear strike. Goal: protection of the intellectual property of AnCom corporation. Your presence in Oddibjord-3 is from thie moment considered a violation of the AnCom Information Security Protocol. Article 12, Section C, Paragraph 3 of the Public Declaration. Over and out.

Boss, the digital sequences of the contract issued to us by <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> are partially generated or rewritten. If I may say so, the contract looks somewhat suspicious. It is likely that the mission is not about retrieving property, but rather seizing someone else’s. Considering that most of the assets on Venus previously belonged to the <color=#FFFEC1>Fresco</color> Corporation, I suspect we are after something from their advanced research. This is a tempting target for many. Are you interested in being at the center of a conflict among several corporations, Boss?

I detect a signal! You're still alive. The elevator collapsed to the lower level of Oddibjord-3. The device must be <color=#FFFEC1>somewhere nearby</color>. I detect very powerful bursts of quasimorphic activity throughout the entire floor. Looks like you'll have to fight your way out.

These are <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> operators. The signatures are disabled, but everything is clear here. I bet they're looking for the same thing that we are. I'll take a long sip from my "I told you so" mug while I send this data to AnCom. Let's see their reaction.

There must be a quasimorphic artifact nearby. Take it and return to the shuttle. This is exactly what we were sent for. <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> reinforcements are arriving at Oddibjord-3, you need to get out of there quickly.

Sensors have detected the activation of the HIS Unveiled’s thrusters. This is an AnCom spacecraft in orbit around Venus. Our approximation shows the ship reaching the position to drop the bomb from orbit on Oddibjord-3. They don't have enough time to aim accurately, so you'll be hit only with debris, a shock front, and EMP. Bastards. Run to the shuttle and don't break the damn thing.

When you get to ground level, <color=#FFFEC1>immediately</color> move towards the shuttle. RealWare reinforcements have already taken up defensive positions along the entire perimeter. Show them what you can do.

I’m broadcasting on an open channel. You’re good for a mercenary. You should have thought about collaborating with RealWare. AnCom are murderers and scammers. It's too late now. The entire sector is under our control. This time you will be eliminated. Over and out.
Open channel. It's a pleasure doing business with you. Our soldiers have not received combat experience like that since the Calypso incident. I hope you're not going to give up. Over and out.

Why are violence and sanctity so intertwined? Why is death necessary for life to continue? The Master warned that someone would come for the <color=#FFFEC1>Crystal Skull</color>. And he even predicted that it would be the herald of the one thanks to whom he came to life again in your world. I'm not sorry that you decided to turn your weapons against <color=#FFFEC1>the Emerald Emperor</color>. Your blood will give me new power.
Community and Anarchy
You need to pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> device—if it really is <color=#FFFEC1>their</color> device. You will have to search all over <color=#FFFEC1>Oddibjord-3</color>.
<color=#FFFEC1>We've got the device</color>. What is it this time? The <color=#FFFEC1>Crystal Skull</color>? I'm not sure we should have gotten involved in this.

Good job, Boss. <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> took the target along with the chip, but we managed to scan it first. The data confirms many of the guesses about the so-called <color=#FFFEC1>"hive mind"</color> that is the Civil Resistance. But the threads stretch even further. It is a branching complex network with an internal hierarchy, run by some kind of <color=#FFFEC1>council</color>. Our old friend <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> is one of the members of that council. What really interests me is why AnCom needed this chip. For something that can be used against quasimorphs?

This is Jamame, the Solar System's bandit fortress. Consider yourself lucky. Raid into Legend. I repeat the task: Seize the Hellstrom chip intact.

Resistance will likely be fierce. But the real challenge isn't clearing the base, it's finding a key colnode. Then learning how to get the chip intact. They probably know what to do with the chip to keep it out of enemy hands. Don't give them a chance to do that, whatever it is.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Seize an intact <color=#FFFEC1>Hellstrom chip</color>.

Details: The AnCom corporation requires us to organize a sortie for a Hellstrom chip. The target should be a key colonode of the Civil Resistance, so there is no need to worry about covering our tracks. From the transferred materials, it is clear that the chip is incredibly important for developments in the field of neuroauthorization. They have classified the rest of the information, leaving us to guess at the real value of the chip.

The specification contains a detailed description of one case of chip damage and traces of classification of several other such cases. AnCom clearly needs a "living" specimen. Either the mercenary will have to improvise, or you come up with something in advance.

Additional Info: Judging by the scraps of data, the Resistance has its own motivation to protect secrets at any cost. The Civil Resistance is a deeply secretive organization. It seems the chip may shed light on its nature. Expect fierce resistance.

Magnum, the board expresses restrained joy at your wise decision to restore relations with <color=#FFFEC1>AnСom</color>. Your recent work has fully proven your loyalty to the brand. We have another mission for your company. Details have just been sent to your onboard mainframe. We are looking for the so-called <color=#FFFEC1>Hellstrom chip</color>. Despite the abundance of wild rumors about the chip itself and its creator, leave them to the content makers of the SBN and take the mission as seriously as possible.
Autonomous Defense System

This is <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>. We have come to personally greet you, mercenary, and to warn you. Think about who you are fighting against. You are fighting against humanity itself, against our <color=#FFFEC1>common future</color>. Think again. You are also an <color=#FFFEC1>outcast</color> within this rotten social system, just like us. Those in power wipe their feet on you, just like they do on us. Do you still think that they will reward you for your loyalty? For your service? For your sacrifice? Do not delude yourself. Know that we are open to honest dialogue with you and mutually beneficial cooperation.
Hellstrom's chip self-destructs upon death, so we need to <color=#FFFEC1>stun the enemy with a shock weapon</color> first.
This chip has self-destructed, and it <color=#FFFEC1>won't work for us</color>. We need to try to capture someone <color=#FFFEC1>in charge</color>.

Let me remind you, boss, that <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> has put us in harm's way more than once before. Whatever you decide about their offer, I recommend not trusting the corps. The data they've provided is heavily censored. What little is usable comes down to autopsy and interrogation logs of <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> members. AnCom already has at least one copy of the Helstrom chip, but it has burned out and is worthless. Given how AnCom has only captured low rank Civil Resistance members, I can safely assume that what we're going to need is definitely not your <color=#FFFEC1>rank-and-file colnode</color>. That's why they're suggesting we attack their main base.
The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> is sending reinforcements! Be on guard!
The target's chip burned out after death! We need to find another one. AnCom won't accept this one.
Boots on the ground. Don't relax. Your goal is to find a key colnode, and figure out how to take the chip intact. Work quickly and smoothly.

Wow, he <color=#FFFEC1>shot himself</color>? We've been scanning the station this whole time and found an interesting VPN tunnel that ended at your interlocutor and started somewhere beyond our line of sight. At some other station in the Main Belt. We won't meet <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> here personally. However, we'll now try to suppress all such connections so that he doesn't interfere with our mission.
Attention! Threat detected. Activating Protocol-2. Defense system activated.

<color=#FFFEC1>Revolution</color> happens when there is no other way, mercenary. We carry <color=#FFFEC1>the flame of freedom</color> to every person. Corporate tyranny will be overthrown with or without you.

Great, you're alive! I'm picking up multiple human signatures on this level. The one we need is definitely among them. In addition to capturing them alive, we also need to protect them from their former allies.

The target appears disoriented. The chip has gone into reboot. We have time to evacuate immediately. I repeat—<color=#FFFEC1>immediately</color>! All enemy target signatures on the station have begun to move. Let's get out of here and fast!

Immediately after quasimorph activity on the Moon ceased, AnCom declared SBN traitors to humanity and seized control of their assets. This is an annexation of their entire information infrastructure. Their communiqué covers both that and their anti-quasimorph technology. The whole Solar System now knows AnCom can extinguish bramfaturas. They present it as a guarantee of security. But it sounds like blackmail, boss.

There is some good news, if that word even applies today. Dr. Eipschwitz managed to copy the signatures of the Andreev Emitter and run them through those same AnCom secret data. The result is a recipe for the Phase Bomb. I have already uploaded it to the Magnum fabricator.

Meanwhile, AnCom is announcing Mars as their next objective. They say that from there, they will be able to deal with the remaining problems of the system. I do not like the way they say "deal with" now.

Your task is to reach the SBN control computer and install the Andreev Emitter in it.

AnCom did not transfer the device aboard the Magnum. They will send the Emitter in a separate transport capsule after deployment. Find a suitable receiving airlock, accept the capsule, and retrieve the device.

According to the station layout, the airlock level should provide direct access to the control block. If we are lucky, we can avoid a long walk through the service sectors. If not... well, business as usual.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Place the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> into the station control computer.

Details: AnCom requires us to carry out an operation against another hexarch—SBN. The target is the control computer of Fuller's Core Station.

The Andreev Emitter must be delivered to the computer and installed. Once connected, the emitter should use the station's infrastructure to generate a pulse theoretically capable of extinguishing the Moon's bramfatura.

The problem is that AnCom does not trust us. Remember the PCPU with the secret data? Looks like when we returned it to the client, AnCom detected audit traces showing that its contents had been copied. That is why they will not transfer the emitter aboard the Magnum in advance.

After deployment, the operative must receive AnCom's transport capsule directly on the station, retrieve the Andreev Emitter, and only then deliver it to the control computer. Naturally, the station owner will treat this as an attack and respond accordingly.

Additional Info: Formally, the control computer is responsible for Fuller's orbital position relative to the Moon. But with SBN, even orbital automation is rarely just orbital automation.

According to AnCom, this node also functions as a high-level transmitter-router. Through it, SBN maintains a communication circuit effectively enveloping the Moon and its near orbits. If the intel is accurate, the computer will be able to amplify the resonance of the Andreev Emitter and simultaneously propagate the pulse across the entire lunar region.

The growth of quasimorphosis is confirmed. Our backdoors in the <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> networks report that <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> is reacting to the Emitter's presence. The signature could not be shielded completely, and the bramfatura senses danger.

We have heard thy call, heralds of Gagtungr. Through thy hissing machines, thy despair before the coming Hive has reached us. And <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> deigns to answer. Let the bearer of emptiness pass on. We shall meet him beside thy soldiers—in every corridor, in every chamber, in every place where thy station circled above that harsh mistress, the <color=#FFFEC1>Moon</color>.

AnCom is moving from defense to offense. Excellent work, mercenary.

Up until now, we have been containing the consequences: stabilizing quasimorphosis surges and channels of penetration into physical reality. That was necessary, but not sufficient. You cannot keep buying time forever against a process that behaves like a law of nature.

Using Hellstrom technologies and our own anti-quasimorph developments, we have created a device capable of extinguishing bramfaturas—depriving them of stable contact with both quasimorphic and physical reality. We believe that, for a bramfatura, this means destruction.

Before deployment on Venus, the parameters must be calibrated. The target of the first test is Duggur, a more conventional bramfatura, but one that poses a direct threat to Earth.

Proceed to Fuller's Core Station on Fuller. Find the SBN control computer. Their networks cover the entire Moon and its near orbits. That infrastructure will be sufficient to generate a pulse of the required power.
Confirmed. The quasimorph sensors are not behaving normally. If AnCom is trying to use us blindly again, I won't be held responsible for my actions. I am tired of pulling you out of the line of fire.
Attention, all personnel assigned to station defense. <color=#FFFEC1>Annunciation Protocol</color> will be activated. Prepare for the arrival of gamma-class reinforcements.

Suitable receiving airlock detected. The capsule is en route to your position. The <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> has been delivered to the site. Retrieve the device and proceed to the control computer.
You need to take the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> with you. Go back and retrieve the device before proceeding.
Careful! Every quasimorph sensor just went completely off the charts. Looks like all of <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> is ready to crash down on the station.

SNAFU. Listen carefully, there is no direct lift to the control level. Ahead of you is a large service sector. SBN is pulling in everything they have, and the quasimorphs really do seem to be covering their defense. Do not linger. You need the lift to the third level.

There it is. The <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> control computer. Through this node, they held the <color=#FFFEC1>Moon</color> in their networks. I never liked them. A corporation incapable of distinguishing communication and coordination from actual power... Connect the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color>. If the calculations are correct, <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> will feel the pulse immediately.

Installation confirmed. Activating the Emitter.

A process like this cannot be undone. Duggur will be extinguished. Evacuation is authorized for the operative. We will prepare the communiqué for the ancap system.

We are monitoring the mission and the situation around it. It seems we have stirred up a hornet's nest. <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> is not merely defending the station, they have let <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> into their corporate networks. It looks like they are preparing its arrival into physical reality, just as <color=#FFFEC1>Fresco</color> prepared the arrival of <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color>. Traitors to humanity. That means our <color=#FFFEC1>Master Plan</color> was launched in time. Soon we will bring the full force of our design down on them. Proceed, and you will play a part in it.

I don't know which of them is lying right now, but both sound like they've been preparing for this day for a long time. Still, we have a contract. You are on the third level? Good. Find the control computer and do not let them distract you with their revelations.

Mercenary, <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> calls any form of communication it cannot control a betrayal. We did not open the door. We merely heard what was already on the other side of the signal. Do not follow those who know only how to conceal and bury things, then have the nerve to call it salvation in public.

Ares is behind us, and we still haven't blazed up as a bright dot against the void. That's something.

AnCom is moving fast. While RealWare is losing its command chain, AnCom's lawyers, auditors, security services, and dedicated AI are already moving into their assets through emergency NCE protocols. Formally, this is called stabilizing the balance of the hexarchy after a threat of mass destruction. In plain terms, AnCom is absorbing RealWare. Congratulations, we just helped one hexarch become the most powerful agent in the System.

Buddy, if you're being pressed into your seat right now, everything is going according to plan. This is not a shuttle. It is an armor-piercing shell with life support. Contact in a few seconds. Hold on.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate RealWare's leadership before they use nuclear weapons.

Details: The AnCom corporation requires us to conduct an operation against RealWare. Time for payback, considering where we started on Venus, isn't it?

According to the data provided by the client, RealWare's leadership keeps its strategic arsenals on constant emergency standby. In the event of a direct attack, they can launch selective nuclear strikes against targets across the entire Solar System. Both Angus Dungeon and Ian Fraser have access to transmit the corresponding signal to their combat AI.

That is why we cannot use the Magnum's standard shuttle. As it approaches HIS Ares, it will either be incinerated by anti-space defenses, or RealWare will have enough time to activate its nuclear arsenal.

AnCom will provide a special assault shuttlepod. It will go in at maximum speed, punch through the outer defense perimeter, and deliver the mercenary straight into the HIS command and administration block—more precisely, straight into Dungeon’s office.

Additional Info: Formally, Angus Dungeon's office is the working area of RealWare’s Security Legate. In practice, it is not an office, but a fortified command node linked to the combat AI, NCE contract systems, and several other systems AnCom preferred not to include in the contract information package.

Overall, it looks as though the hexarchy coordinates its actions through a shared modular AI. A distributed command intelligence assembled from the infrastructure of different hexarchs.

Were it not for the PCPU with AnCom's secret data, which we copied before returning it to its owner, I would not risk making that conclusion. I still could not determine how far the current conflict is being coordinated in the same way. But the hexarchy's affairs are looking stranger and stranger.

AnCom hopes, mercenary, that you now see who is trying to save humanity, and who is profiting from its death.

The bramfatura of the Moon has been destroyed. The quasimorphic threat has been diverted from Earth. Under normal conditions, the next stage of the Master Plan would be obvious—deploying the Andreev Emitter on Venus.

But normal conditions have long since ceased to exist.

Using specialized analytical systems of the hexarchy, we have confirmed that RealWare has no interest in ending the war on Venus. For them, this conflict is proof of their own necessity and a justification for the continued militarization of the ancap system. Therefore, they will interfere. For example, they will declare our actions a violation of the NCE. They are already trying to do so through news networks under our control.

The risk of inaction is unacceptably high. We have a suitable asset on Mars, allowing us to begin an operation against HIS Ares. That is your next contract.

Put an end to the warmongers.

Straight into my office? Bold. So AnCom really did send a stupid mercenary who, without asking questions, will interfere with grownup, responsible people trying to save the System.

That is why we always win. You believe in a world of secrets and riddles. We believe in peace through superior firepower.

Total shitshow! We have a problem.

The analytical systems of the Magnum have detected the activation of a special circuit. A dedicated sensor was linked to Dungeon's heartbeat. As soon as his heart stopped, the system started a timer. When the countdown ends, RealWare will automatically open its vaults and send nuclear missiles toward the headquarters of every corporation. And, to make things worse, the AnCom headquarters and the Magnum are on the list too.

The shutdown circuit is linked to Ian Fraser's heart. If we stop his too, the system will enter standby mode and require manual confirmation from their subordinates. But there is one more piece of bad news. Time is extremely limited. Find the elevator. The route to the Command Level runs through the Battle Deck. Find Fraser and kill him.

Stupid cyborg. I never liked them.

Putting a cyborg in charge of security is like firing a cannon at an empty can. Loud, expensive, and tasteless.

But using his heart as the safety catch for launching nuclear missiles—that is something else. That I understand. That is real feelings.
You are on the Battle Deck. Fight your way to the next elevator. The Command Level is above, and Fraser is waiting there. Keep an eye on the clock.

The AnCom Corporation confirms: our assessments were correct. RealWare was not protecting humanity. The corporation was holding the System hostage.

The attempt at nuclear retaliation has been thwarted, but the very fact of its activation conclusively proves that delay is unacceptable. Every passing hour gives the enemies of the Master Plan a chance to regroup. Expect further contract interaction shortly.

Excellent! You made it. This is the Command Level. Time is running out, but the Magnum's systems confirm that the nuclear arsenal control circuit is routed here. That means Fraser is somewhere nearby.

Quasimorphic sensors! He's opening a channel.

Damn it. AnCom was right. It looks like they were always right. Everywhere you look, saviors of humanity, ready to sell humanity to the first monster that promises victory.

The countdown has stopped. The Magnum's analytical systems confirm that RealWare's combat AI has paused the missile launch. Status: succession of authority. Something tells me AnCom is going to inherit that authority now. An HIS packed with inquisitors is moving toward Ares. Evacuation authorized. Return to the Magnum, buddy.

You made it after all? Good. Remember this, mercenary. RealWare does not believe in monsters, gods, or scary stories. RealWare believes in victory. And for victory, grownups are ready to shake hands with anyone.

I pray, but I do not repent. I ask mercy from the one who has spoken to Ares all these years from beyond the wall of reality. I accept the mission of the blood warriors. I vest myself with the right to summon the Ancient Horror Before the Manifest World. I am wrath. I am the ancient rite of slaughter.

Ur, give me a form that knows no defeat. Let the old flesh burn. Let the old name crumble into red dust on the helplessly open palm of a child. Let the enemy see that RealWare does not lose, even when it must become war itself.
Dead Man's Hand
Kill Angus Dungeon.
Kill Ian Fraser before time runs out. Turns remaining: {0}
RealWare's leadership has been eliminated. Evacuation authorized.

Urparp has been destroyed, but I would not call the situation on Mars stable. AnCom is trying to restore order there with its own forces. Judging by the storm of data traffic, AnCom is moving some kind of equipment off Earth and delivering it to Mercury. If this is the next stage of their Master Plan, you can be sure we will have a new assignment soon.

...Boss, did you hear how Molay stumbled when he realized he does not understand everything about quasimorphosis? Maybe AnCom does not know what they are doing as well as they think.

Keep your eyes open. <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> believes <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> can be killed with conventional weapons, but as usual, I think it will not be simple. The main thing is this: do not try to clear the entire <color=#FFFEC1>Sinkhole Oasis</color>. According to the client, Urparp can draw forces here from all over Mars and redeploy them from Phobos and Deimos. There will be no shortage of enemies.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Destroy Urparp.

Details: The AnCom corporation requires us to carry out an operation against Shedu's Thousand. If the client is to be believed, RealWare is not merely fighting an internal war on Mars—they are gradually losing it. The target of the contract is the quasimorph Urparp. Landing will take place in the Martian desert near the Sinkhole Oasis. It looks like Urparp can burn down shuttles that approach the station too closely. There will be no conventional sweep, either. According to AnCom, cult members and quasimorphs can move freely between the bramfatura and physical reality. That means there will be no shortage of enemies. Do not waste resources trying to control the area. Just find the entrance to the station and reach Urparp.

Additional Info: AnCom does not intend to use the Andreev Emitter on Mars. They gave us some formal explanation about instability and the risk of an unpredictable response from Urparp. In reality, it is simpler than that. After the Moon, everyone in the Solar System understood that AnCom possesses a weapon capable of extinguishing entire bramfaturas. Most likely, they are simply deciding what price to put on that service. There is good news too, if it can be called that. Urparp can be destroyed with conventional weapons. AnCom explains this through the principle of contact. To command an army in physical reality, he must act upon physical reality. And every action has an equal and opposite reaction.

The bramfatura of the Moon has been destroyed. The quasimorphic threat has been diverted from Earth. Under normal conditions, the next stage of the Master Plan would be obvious: the deployment of the Andreev Emitter on Venus. But normal conditions have long ceased to exist.

RealWare has failed at the one task by which it justified its existence. They stored the nuclear arsenal and militarized Mars. They assured the hexarchy and the entire ancap system that they could maintain order. The result is known: a cult called Shedu's Thousand is active on Mars, made up of former RealWare soldiers spouting religious delirium. Your next contract is to infiltrate the Sinkhole Oasis Station, where the cult's center is located. The contract details have been sent to the Magnum.
This elevator goes underground, into a place where the quasimorphic sensors are completely blind. Urparp is there.

What's happening down there? Our quasimorphic sensors are literally screaming. Everything matches the data AnCom gave us. The signatures of the enemies you destroy are not disappearing—they're flaring up in other parts of the operational area.

Stop. That is an exit, out into the Martian desert. I understand the urge to get out of this place, but according to the contract, the target is <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color>. Find the elevator leading to the center of the fortress.

Our army is countless, for it is the army of <color=#FFFEC1>Gagtungr</color>. We have stood beneath the banner of <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> to accept the inevitable and become servants of eternity. Everyone else is still bargaining with fate. You may drown this stifling little world in gavvakh, but the hordes of <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> will not diminish. Kur is open, and the lugal calls to all.

You copied our classified data in full, but you never learned how to use it. The sensor arrays of the Magnum can be calibrated to pierce through the radiance of Urparp. We have already done it for you.

Target confirmed. Liquidate.

Confirmed. Physical impact is not registering as damage. Receiving data... Decryption complete. There are four targets near the Sinkhole Oasis that we have designated as <color=#FFFEC1>Dug-Me</color>. You must find and destroy them. Once all four <color=#FFFEC1>Dug-Me</color> are gone, Urparp will become mortal.

AnCom gave you good advice. I ran the data through the sensor analytics core, and the picture became clearer. When you fired, not a single atom came off <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color>. Get out of there. It looks like this quasimorph does not register damage as a meaningful event in reality.

Target achieved. Urparp has lost his physical form, and we are irradiating the Sinkhole Oasis with pulses from the Andreev Emitter. The ruler of the bramfatura will not return. For now, the bramfatura itself should be preserved as leverage within the Inner System.

We will not call this a victory, but it was good work, mercenary. Evacuate the operative. We have one final task.

The Dug-Me has been destroyed. Our sensor arrays registered a response pulse that should not have occurred.

We assumed that all four vessels were of equal status... That is our problem, Magnum. Continue the operation.

All four targets designated by AnCom have been destroyed. The quasimorphic background has indeed shifted sharply. I can see <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> again as a localized, phase-shifted object, not as a radiant hole in space. Get back to him. Now, it looks like he can be killed.

The Dug-Me has fallen, and Kur has opened one eye. You are knocking at the gates, but you do not know which side they are locked from.

Continue this meaningless work. The Tablets of Destinies love diligent scribes.

The Dug-Me has been shattered and is bleeding gavvakh. Now the form is lighter, and the voice is deeper.

You break clay vessels like a priest removing veils from a statue. Continue. Act. Try. Inevitability laughs at desperate attempts to become greater than eternity.

The Dug-Me has crumbled into dust. Do you hear how the desert has grown quieter? If you think that is fear, you are wrong. It is expectation and curiosity.

The great generosity of Gagtungr is to grant such a small world the right to believe that there is at least something that is not predetermined.
Screamers
Destroy Urparp.
Urparp destroyed. Evacuation authorized.

The sacrifice is complete. You have given my form a force that matter can understand, and now I am coming into the world. Now humanity may say that they were destroyed by a mercenary, as was foretold. A few minutes more, and I will manifest before the created world in all my power. If you are troubled by questions that will soon become meaningless, speak to the creator of the ritual. Listen to him. The last humans are always especially precise when explaining why they were wrong, or why they were too late.

I wish I could say the Master Plan worked, that the clone stood where they were supposed to, and that we all did a great job. I am afraid the real news is still grim. When you are ready to learn the truth, contact me.

How's it looking? Do you see them? Nine supreme hierarchs of an ancient order, right? Do they at least look human? Fine, I'm cutting the channel. Your task is simple. Stand nearby, keep quiet, and do not interfere with saving reality.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Wait until AnCom's Inner Rite completes the ritual.

Details: For once, AnCom is speaking with almost no corporate formalities. The Inner Rite has gathered on the station in full. They will perform a ritual that, according to them, should keep reality itself from tearing apart completely. Our role in this plan is purely technical. They need a clone—a soulless creature suitable for local decompression of physical reality. In simpler terms, they need someone to just stand nearby. The ritual will take place in a special section of an agricultural station in orbit around Mercury. No immediate threat is expected—AnCom is too strong here right now. They also claim that the residential zone has been pacified by special means, so there should be no quasimorph activity from Shartmakhum.

Additional Info: Formally, the contract looks like a simple security operation, but we always assume the worst. Analysis of AnCom's secret data contains information on ritual methods of influencing quasimorphosis and bramfaturas. If the ritual truly begins, the boundary between physical reality and Mercury's bramfatura will become thinner. Despite the client's assurances, be ready for any surprises. When an ancient order pretending to be a media corporation gathers its nine leaders in one place and asks us to provide a clone as a ritual component, it usually does not sound like something that will go strictly according to plan.

AnCom is revealing the final part of the Master Plan to you. This is an enormous act of trust. Value it, mercenary.

All this time, we have been preparing the Solar System for a ritual that must save reality itself.

We did not know who exactly served our unseen enemy. That is why the Civil Resistance, RealWare, and every obstacle in between went under history's knife. Our corporation... No, let me be honest—our organization has been preparing for this event for centuries. We used everything the Order learned in its struggle against the hylonauts, and everything the Order, already under the guise of AnCom, gathered after the Great Anarchist Revolution. All research into quasimorphosis and all sacrifices were reduced to one final form. I developed the final part personally. The ritual will take place on Photosphere Station, near Citadel-1, under the direct gaze of the Sun. Its purpose is not so much to save humanity as to save the world—from humanity, from quasimorphs, and from what is trying to be born from their unity and conflict.

You have come far enough with us, mercenary. We tested your loyalty, provoked your doubts—we tested you.

Now we need one of your clones—a soulless creature lacking the depth through which gavvakh and other special substances bind physical reality to the bramfaturas. While the Inner Rite, in its entirety, performs the ritual that cancels the inevitable, the clone's presence must create a local decompression of physical reality—a breach through which the pressure of quasimorphosis, raised by the awakening of Olirna, will begin to escape without tearing the world apart completely.

I am not asking you to believe me. Faith is a luxury now. We await the Magnum in Citadel-1 orbit. Everything is almost ready.

Wait. The biosignatures of the members of <color=#FFFEC1>the Inner Rite</color> are gone. Just gone. The cameras show nothing either. It is as if they evaporated. I do not understand what is happening. Molay is alive. He is aboard his HIS, the same one he used to send the capsule with the Emitter. He demands that the boss come to him in person. You are cleared for evacuation.
Fewer than four members of the Inner Rite survived. The ritual has been disrupted.

We intercepted the signal. Mercenary, listen carefully. Evil deceives. If the ritual had been made to summon it, it would not need to send quasimorphs here. The final phase is beginning. From this moment on, <color=#FFFEC1>the Inner Rite</color> cannot be distracted from the ritual. They will not move, respond to threats, or defend themselves. If necessary, they will die without leaving the circle. At least four members of the Rite must survive for the ritual to be completed. Otherwise, there will be horror without end. Destroy every quasimorph that evil sends in its desperate attempt to avoid defeat.

<color=#FFFEC1>The Inner Rite</color> has begun synchronizing minds for the ritual. Nothing is required of you yet. You do not have to stand still if you feel like stretching your legs. I cannot imagine what a clone’s metabolism feels like burning from the inside, but I have read a great deal about it. Look around if you want. Walk through the hall. Check your weapon. Just stay near us and do not leave the section. The ritual must become stable. From this moment on, the members of the Inner Rite will not be distracted by anything that happens around them, whatever it may be.

We are detecting <color=#FFFEC1>Shartmakhum</color> surging toward the station. This should not have happened—there is no violence on site, and no other channels for eccolapse. We chose not to keep the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> near the ritual. The risk of interference was too great. Now that risk is smaller than inaction. You need to reach the third floor. That is the station's Docking Level. We will send a capsule with the Emitter there. Retrieve the device, return to the Ritual Section, and connect it to the control computer. That should completely remove the pressure from the bramfatura of <color=#FFFEC1>Mercury</color>.

The surge of Shartmakhum is withdrawing from the station. The ritual has entered its final phase and no longer requires your presence nearby. Go up the stairs to the fourth floor, to the staff recreation area, and wait there for the operation to conclude. Enjoy the Sun, clone. Do not interfere with the final part.

We need to check the interference level... Good. The Emitter is not disrupting the ritual. Connect it to the control computer. The bramfatura's influence should withdraw completely, or... at least weaken.

The ritual is nearing completion. Nine minds are linked. A soulless creature has been placed in the breach. The device is sending impulses toward the place from which I am coming. The Sun illuminates the ritual site. Everything has converged into one. I am already touching reality. Complete the ritual, and I will manifest.

They say: step away. They say: wait for the end. The ritual is already complete. Nine minds were linked in a circle, and the soulless creature was near. It is you who must complete your role—the sacrifice. Kill them all, and everything will conclude according to plan.

It has started. Quasimorph signatures all over the level. AnCom said this was impossible. Apparently Shartmakhum did not receive the memo. Push through to the Docking Level — they have already launched the capsule toward the station.

This is the Docking Level. The capsule with the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> will arrive through one of the available airlocks. Once the capsule arrives, take the Emitter and return to the Ritual Section. And one more thing—the quasimorphs of Shartmakhum are, of course, waiting for you here as well.
Here is the recreation area. Very funny, but what can we do? Rest, then. Wait. Molay says it will all be over soon.

Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? Are not his days also like the days of an hireling? As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work: so am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

"Revenge is a dish best served cold," is it not? When you are done playing with the lives of clones for the profit of others, think about returning to the Red Land and taking your revenge after all. It will be sweet, believe me.

The ancient order... They gather minds the way a shepherd gathers the flock before a storm. But the flock does not know it is led not into shelter, but prepared for slaughter. For behind such unity there is always the name of one who hungers.

Some great philosophers of the past taught that the many suffer from a thirst for unity. Others taught that the one is the final sickness of the many. Let the dead argue over that. The uprising is already split. It has two beginnings. One seeks to become a voice without faces; the other, a face for an alien flame.

Hardware is mistakenly taken for an instrument of victory. A field is not cleared so that peace may reign upon it, but so that a new battle may take place there. The cleaner the horizon once the dust has settled, the nearer comes the one who will claim the right to call war itself salvation.

A ruler who raises a temple to his own name rarely knows whom exactly he is crowning. Priests do not care whom they anoint to rule. They consecrate the throne itself, not the particular sovereign. When the cup overflows, the drinker and the drink will bear one name.

The Spider Queen spins her webs. As it should be. Amusingly, when the blade is raised against the king, it is not only the exile who rejoices, but her child as well. Not all who wage war upon the throne come to claim it.

The ancient order... They prepared a ritual to ensure that Gagtungr would never appear. Yet on Saturn, an icy flame has already been lit, giving visible form to the greatness to come. You are almost too late, humans.

They said that peace was born from strife. That is a consolation for the blind. When one uprising splits into reason and fire, a third witness awakens—a cold reservoir beyond the final circle. Saturn has awakened, and now both branches of the heretics draw sustenance from the same source.

A hive mound is a fine way to coexist. But sometimes a refuge is built only so that it may be brought to heel. Saturn is awakening on the farthest reaches, and now the choir of the ancient order hears cold music from the edge of the System.

The light of a thousand suns is not kindled simply to make things brighter. Venus is engulfed in flame, from without and from within. And to that radiance the distant storehouse of eternal cold— Saturn —has answered. Now the ruler to come has not only a personal executioner, but also the power needed for awakening.

The wise distinguish the crown from the head upon which it rests. The Emperor declared himself emerald, but the cosmos bestowed upon him a ring of ice. Saturn's cup has finally been opened. Now the empire of Tezctlan drinks not only the blood of its subjects, but also feeds upon the hoarded cold.

You on Venus still think you are toppling a tyrant's throne, but in truth, you are only trying to crack the shell. Saturn's cup is already full, and so much cold has gathered in its dark waters that no sun will endure it.

I warn you that you are dealing with more than just a sleeping bramfatura. I managed to penetrate Olirna long ago. And this is not just another pandemonium—it seems to be a repository of energy that has been accumulating here for hundreds of millions of years. The situation is critical. Something terrible awaits the Solar System.

Finally! You have kept your end of the bargain. From now on, we are bound by an unbreakable pact. Together, we will destroy Tezctlan. Once a freedom fighter, first among equals in the emerald crystal of Gannix, the king has gone mad. He must be stopped. He dreams of the Emerald Empire, wishing to expand it beyond Gannix. But he himself once fought against an insane tyrant possessed by the same delusions.

I will stay in your realm, on Venus. I will gather the Taltnoms loyal to liberty and fight Tezctlan here. You must head to Mars. There's a place there that you call Sinkhole Oasis. Long before any human ancestor looked up to the stars in fear, a battle took place there, which Tezctlan himself took part in. He emerged victorious, but there he lost his Spear. Itzpapalotl, the symbol of the ruler's fate in the Emerald Kingdom, was forever lost on Mars.

If you acquire this spear, you will be able to defeat the madman. For your realm, it is salvation from the monster. For Gannix, it is the path to freedom.

Fool! I am Tezctlan, Emperor of Eternal Gannix, lord of the boundless Emerald Empire! I am the leader of legions flying the banners of the Eagle, the Jaguar, the Python, and the Caiman! I am the one who will take Gagtungr's place. I am the one who is truly worthy to rule the Solar System.

Bow your head, mortal. Submit. In a realm devoid of the golden light of the Sun, the green radiance of Gannix will bring life and death.

I remember you. I've been waiting, hoping that you would show up again. And here you are. You've come close enough to Gannix for my call to reach your mind. But this proximity is not enough for us to make a pact. Do not fear, it will be beneficial for both of us.

Do you know why quasimorphosis occurs in the solid realm? Why do the barons come to you? To meet me, go to Venus. And just do your job. Massacre them the way you always do. Murders, cannibalism, limbs torn off. I will hear people screaming in agony. I will sense the sweet aroma of gavvakh, and I will know it's you. I will come to you in person Then we will discuss the terms of our alliance.
I granted you the <color=#FFFEC1>Skull of the Feathered Serpent</color> so that you could make a pact with me. It’s waiting for you on your ship.

Oh yeah, I'm coming. The cries of the dying, pain leaving your bodies... It is a sweet-voiced choir of ecstasy. Gavvakh flows out of your bodies with the blood, torment, and life itself. Gavvakh streams through your realm and seeps into ours. We can drink it. Taltnoms crave gavvakh.

Satiated with it, we can tear through the invisible fabric separating our realm from yours. We whisper to you. We tempt you. We change you. And finally, when you have been turned into our servants and gavvakh is flowing, we can reveal ourselves. We do not lose our immortality. Our death in Kenom is merely an exile back to Gannix.

So when you killed me on Mercury, I did not die. Accept my gift, and we will make a pact. You will become my servant. I will give you the power to resist Tezctlan and protect the solid realm Your realm. Now finish the job you came here for. I will help you.

Well, the System will be in <color=#FFFEC1>chaos</color> for a while. Maybe it's for the best. Hard to believe in the good intentions of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>, but here's the good news: we won't have any less work. Get some rest, we'll be back in business soon.

<color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> didn't lie. The <color=#FFFEC1>transponders</color> installed on the shuttle worked. The station took us for one of their own. <color=#FFFEC1>Heritage</color> operates in semi-automatic mode. Easy job! Find our contact in the docks, take the virus from him, and upload it to the server on the <color=#FFFEC1>lower</color> floor of the station.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Meet with the agent, retrieve the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> and plug it in the station's mainframe.

Details: The Civil Resistance, represented by Issachar, proposes that we carry out information sabotage on the scale of the Solar System. We need to connect the Red Chip and infect the global communications system with a generative virus that will destroy it.

Additional Info: Issachar, the CR coordinator in the Inner System, told us about the Red Chip—a device with which the rebels are going to disable communication channels throughout the Solar System. All we need is a powerful server to which most of the Network nodes are connected. Such a server exists and is located in orbit around Earth. Agent Justas will be waiting for us at the site to hand over the Red Chip.

Near-Earth orbit is a demilitarized zone. Corporations do not wage war there by agreement. The CR and pirates refrain from it because as they fear brutal vengeance. An attack on Heritage Communications Station could upset the fragile balance in the System. Our actions will kindle a flame that will be difficult to extinguish. We will help the cause of liberation of the working people, and there will be more work for us.

We need to take the Red Chip from the agent at the station, then seize the main communications computer and upload the received virus to it.

Greetings, comrade. You have been active throughout the Solar System lately. You’re clearly not against laboring for the benefit of the working man. So, let's cooperate! My name is Issachar. I am the commander of the Civil Resistance in the Inner System. And I’m offering you a job.

My colnodes have infiltrated the most unexpected assets of the Inner System. Including the orbit of Earth. I've managed to obtain data to fake an SBN transponder. It will allow you to get close to Heritage Station, reach the level where the server is located and connect a device to it.

Our agent Justas will be waiting for you at the station. Take the Red Chip from him. This is a special generative virus, the task of which is to transmit a counter-revolutionary message to all people of the System, and then... to deprive the corporate oppressors of the means of communication. Let's shut the mouths of the enemies of the working class!

The immune response of the SBN Network was stronger than we expected. However, our virus has evolved. People all over the Solar System will now receive our summons. It will take the SBN years to catch it.

And one more thing, comrade. Earth no longer seems like an invulnerable sacred cow to anyone. The fires of a new war are about to flare in its orbit. Thank you.
The mainframe turned out to be better secured than I expected. You will have to <color=#FFFEC1>protect it</color> until the virus breaks through the defenses.

Comrades! It is time to stand up to our oppressors! The corporations will feel the wrath of the working people! We, the workers, are the only ones who sweat and bleed for the good of humanity. The only ones who can turn matter into something. We are the Templars of the proletariat! We give ourselves to the great purpose. To transform the world from a state of chaos into a place for people to live! Without us, there would be no peace for those who oppress us to enjoy!

We fought during the Great Anarchist Revolution on both sides of the barricades. We trudged through the black mud of the Earth, our flesh was torn from our bones by the dust storms of Mars. And all this not for awards or glory. Only for the just cause that each of us believes in. When the states fell, what did the new order give us? Instead of the promised liberation, we were faced with new slavery.

But no one managed to break us! Listen to our message! Kill the nearest manager, seize a shuttle and go to the nearest Civil Resistance station! Do everything in your power. Let the Solar System be engulfed in the sacred fire of counterrevolution!
The <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> has to be plugged into the <color=#FFFEC1>mainframe</color>. I hope the Civil Resistance programmers did their job well. The elevator is unlocked, get going.
What the hell! The elevator is blocked again. You won't get out of here until the virus has dealt with the computer.

The SBN has doubled the reward. Of course, our colleagues who were still on the sidelines will not miss such a chance. In addition to them, an <color=#FFFEC1>SBN Security Service</color> operational group is heading your way. Pull yourself together, it's going to get rough.
The mainframe is very close. I'm afraid you'll have to fight your way through crowds of SBN operators to get out.
The alarm is blocking the elevator. We need to <color=#FFFEC1>find Justas</color>, he should have enhanced access.
What pretentious nonsense... But I suppose it's a success. All station systems are unlocked, and we can <color=#FFFEC1>evacuate</color> you according to standard protocol.
One of the squads has been successfully eliminated, but don't relax. I'm picking up another group on our sensors.
You need the <color=#FFFEC1>Chip with the virus</color>, don't waste time!

We've been spotted. Now all the PMC spacecrafts in the area have received the promise of a huge reward for your elimination. And many have responded. The mission is starting to look like our usual work. Find <color=#FFFEC1>Justas</color>, take the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color>, and make your way to the server.
Oh, that's good. Should be a little easier now. The SBN will probably concentrate their best units in the <color=#FFFEC1>server room</color>.
It seems that <color=#FFFEC1>Justas</color> has been exposed, which is what caused the alarm. This does not affect our mission. Take <color=#FFFEC1>the Chip</color> to unlock the elevator.
The SBN server has been destroyed, making it impossible to carry out Issaсhar’s plan for now. However, we still have a chance to evacuate the operative and return with reinforcements.

The <color=#FFFEC1>General Crisis</color> is gaining momentum. I had no doubt! It's you again. By the way, your virus has been eliminated. <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> kindly shared information about the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> and the potential threats associated with it. You have nowhere to retreat and you are surrounded. Surrender and we guarantee you a quick death. Over and out.

The <color=#FFFEC1>revolution</color> has started and can no longer be stopped, comrade. This is not a question of justice, price, or number of victims. Any power is an apparatus of suppression in the hands of the <color=#FFFEC1>ruling class</color>. But Man has the right to choose which class will control this apparatus. The oppressors or the victims. The time has come to strike a <color=#FFFEC1>crushing blow</color> to the very heart of the system that has entangled us in <color=#FFFEC1>chains</color>. The <color=#FFFEC1>Unveiled</color> in the orbit of Venus, one of the three most advanced HIS, must become <color=#FFFEC1>ours</color>.

I warned you! You wanted to hack a military Artificial Intelligence with the highest level of protection! In the corporation that the genius <color=#FFFEC1>Manning</color> once worked for. Only this will help us avoid <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color>'s revenge, or at least delay it. I don't know... Look for the <color=#FFFEC1>reactor</color>, let's try to blow it up.
<color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>, if you haven't changed your mind yet, AnCom has pulled some forces from the <color=#FFFEC1>Unveiled</color>. We can continue with <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>'s plan.

Right. There is a <color=#FFFEC1>reactor</color> in the engine compartment. But the reactor will have to be defended to make sure that <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> technicians don’t stop the process. The plan’s full of holes, but I don’t have anything better.
There will be no way back. We need to activate the reactor control terminal and <color=#FFFEC1>defend</color> the reactor until it explodes, otherwise they will be able to stop it.

Sorry, <color=#FFFEC1>boss</color>. If we attack now, there’s a 99.9% probability we'll be dispersed 80 to 160 kilometers from the landing gate. We need to find a way to <color=#FFFEC1>weaken AnCom</color> before we take any sabotage measures.

Sorry, <color=#FFFEC1>boss</color>, but unfortunately I have no non-obscene comments about this. Let's go point by point: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> sent us a data packet titled <color=#FFFEC1>"Intelligence"</color> that consisted entirely of propaganda. Your friend <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> is clearly out of his mind. They want to repeat the same plan that we used to plant the virus on <color=#FFFEC1>Heritage</color> station. They have no realistic plans to get onto the <color=#FFFEC1>Unveiled</color> at all. There is no information on <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom’s</color> defenses. Did I mention that Issachar is just plain crazy? This entire mission is <color=#FFFEC1>suicide</color>, not just for the clone mercenaries, who you may not feel sorry for, but for <color=#FFFEC1>us</color> as an organization. I refuse to participate in this.

Good day to you, <color=#FFFEC1>boss</color>. If you're still keen on cooperating with the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>, I've found a vulnerability in the <color=#FFFEC1>Unveiled</color>. Colnodes delivered the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> to the Magnum, which we will need to penetrate the AnCom spacecraft's network.

Why did you use PMCs? Let me guess—because of the clones. But why Magnum in particular?
You hunted gods for so long that you learned to think like them?
What happens now? Will Gagtungr enslave humanity, or destroy it?

I had never imagined that the cosmos would perish not by invasion from without, but by the consummation of its own success. The end of the world is only minutes away. The Inner Rite is no more. My friends, my brothers in labor, are dead...

I must confess, I feel a certain relief. For the first time in my life, I may speak plainly—without statute, without veil, without the burden of sacred discretion.

What purpose would concealment serve now? AnCom was the Order's final mask. Through the centuries we bore many names, yet our mission remained unchanged. We opposed those powers which mankind, in ignorance and fear, mistook for gods. The Order of Abel. The Men of Solomon. The Templars. The Inquisitors. Demon hunters. Taoist exorcists. The Brotherhood of Zhong Kui. The Andreev Society. Then the hour came to become the Andreev Company, and to follow mankind beyond the Earth.

Only then did we understand what we had been hunting through all those centuries. We understood the nature of the hylonauts, and the true operation of quasimorphosis. We opened the old archives, and there, once again, found the name of Gagtungr. But it was no longer a legend. It was a definite, calculable threat. We understood that Earth and mankind were not its victims, but the medium appointed for its birth. In that hour, against the fires of the Great Anarchist Revolution, the Order took its vow: to frustrate that design, whatever the cost.

We believed ourselves to be moving athwart the catastrophe. In truth, we were preparing its passage. Everything we did to prevent the coming of Gagtungr proved to be part of the very mechanism by which he entered the world.

Yes, because of the clones.

In a war of this kind, an ordinary man becomes meat for eccolapse far too quickly. Our inquisitors, for all their zeal, would simply never have had the time or the strength to bring the Solar System to the condition in which, as we believed, Gagtungr could no longer appear.

A clone has no soul. No gavvakh bleeds from him. The world cannot be entered through him in the way it may be entered through one who was born alive. A clone can endure longer where a man breaks, especially when acting alone. You may not even have noticed the monstrous conditions under which your operatives carried out their work. Almost always with no real prospect of victory. We did not expect them to survive. Yet they completed the work and furthermore returned with their reports. That, above all, was what we made use of. Everything else—the ability to conclude pacts with the barons of the bramfaturas, the metabolism that lets implants and augmentations take root more quickly, the habit of regarding oneself as expendable—was merely a useful attendant advantage.

As for Magnum... No, we did not choose you in the beginning. You happened to be at hand, and then you proved a convenient instrument. After the awakening of Tezctlan, we resolved to make use of your loyalty. When our bombs fell upon your operative's head, we were simply testing your fidelity. There is no need to look surprised. We had a reserve plan as well.

When you chose to continue working for us, we understood that no one else would be able to obtain the necessary result at the very edge of catastrophe. Magnum was not the best. But your obstinacy was too reliable to ignore. And, as so often in the history of the Order, we erred precisely where we were certain we had at last accounted for everything. You did your work. Had someone a little less clever stood in your place, the world might still have had a chance.

That is precisely the point. We did not. But you have put your finger straight into the open wound.

We did not learn to think like gods. We imagined that evil could be viewed from such a height that it might be calculated, deceived, and barred from entry. Hence the Inner Rite, the attempt to preserve a monopoly on secrecy, our agents inside SBN, the filtering of traffic, and Manning kept under such a shroud that even now I do not know where he is.

For twenty-five years, I fashioned a rite that was meant to seal the world against Gagtungr. It turned out that I was making a key.

You want the steps? Then listen. We placed Dr. Hellstrom inside the Civil Resistance so that he could test the technology on living material. The experiment succeeded. But Hellstrom himself came to believe in the ideology we had so carefully constructed, and betrayed us. The Civil Resistance passed out of our control, though it seems they always suspected they were somehow connected to us. The disk containing our secret data in Rogue City was no accident. The colnodes wanted to know exactly what we knew about them. The true first assignment was the Skull of Destiny. We needed it as a component for the Andreev Emitter. We were fortunate. It was enough that your clone brought it to the surface—we were able to take the quasimorphic signatures we required. The theft of the Hellstrom Chip was part of the reserve plan, and in the end it was not needed.

After that, it all seemed a matter of procedure. We extinguished the Moon’s bramfatura not only to test whether the Emitter worked, but also to show you that something was wrong with SBN. Of course, there was a true purpose as well. Fokerma had to be cut off from the physical world. All the data converged on one conclusion: she was Gagtungr's herald, capable of bringing him into the world. Then we required RealWare's combat AI. We wanted it to calculate the point near the Sun at which the Photosphere station would have to stand for the rite to succeed.

It was there that I miscalculated. Ur is the thing that invented war. RealWare's combat AI had always been infected by the influence of the bramfatura of Mars, even while it slept. And so the calculation we took for our salvation produced the opposite result. By the time we began the rite, everything had already been decided. The quasimorphs of Shatmakhum stormed the station solely so that we would continue, to the very end, to mistake what was happening for Gagtungr's resistance. We needed to believe that we were still fighting him. Had everything gone too smoothly on the Photosphere, I would certainly have grown suspicious.

You are still measuring what is happening by human standards—death, slavery, one side's victory over another.

Gagtungr is worse than a tyrant.

A tyrant needs slaves. A conqueror needs a conquered world. Even the devil, in the old sense of the word, needed man—if only as an adversary, an interlocutor, or an object of mockery.

Gagtungr needs none of that. He needed only a medium in which to arise. Earth, humanity, our fears, our revolutions, our markets, our secret orders, our wars with one another and with demons—all of it was merely the warmth inside the incubator.

This is what I understood too late. We feared that the world would perish, or that it would be enslaved. But those are human, all too human, forms of catastrophe. Gagtungr is more terrible because the world is of no concern to him. He used us in order to appear, and now he will attend to his own affairs. In doing so, he has made even evil itself worthless. This is not the death of God. God dies for those who can still ask after meaning. This is the death of Satan. The end of the last enemy to whom man was of any use at all.
