Boss, all across the Solar System, <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> is taking control of stations held by the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>. But that’s not even the biggest news. The <color=#FFFEC1>HIS Invincible</color> has carried out a nuclear strike on the asteroid <color=#FFFEC1>Hecate</color>. Nothing is left of the asteroid. This is the first publicly acknowledged use of nuclear weapons since the <color=#FFFEC1>Great Anarchist Revolution</color>. On <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color>, corporate spokespeople claimed that a secret <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> base was located on <color=#FFFEC1>Hecate</color>. I get it, boss: contracts, security, stability, a chance for someone like you to find a place in this chaos. But doesn't it seem like <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> is already acting as if the entire ancap system belongs to them?

We'll drop you near the base. After that, you're on your own. Find a way inside. The central computer is hidden somewhere on the lower levels, and getting to it won't be easy.

There's a real chance that today marks the end of the Civil Resistance's century-long history—and you'll be the one to end it.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find a way to destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>.

Details: RealWare is launching a series of operations to save the AnCap system from total collapse. They have shared limited projections from their combat AI. While the machine searches for a way to destroy Tezctlan, we are to carry out preemptive strikes against the forces of the Unchained Belt and the Civil Resistance.
The Civil Resistance is fractured by internal struggle. Several factions are fighting for control of the movement, and one of its most dangerous commanders, Issachar, has taken over operational planning in the Inner System. To coordinate his colnodes through the Hellstrom Network, he built a dedicated server and transferred part of his consciousness into it. This allows him to maintain control with maximum efficiency.
Currently, this coordination node is too far away, on Vesta. But Issachar has already begun preparations to relocate it to one of Mars's moons. According to RealWare's combat AI projections, this is the ideal moment to strike. The colnodes are preoccupied with the move, the channels are overloaded, and the control system itself is more vulnerable than usual.
Our task: infiltrate the facility, reach the server, and destroy Issachar. Once the coordinating center falls, his entire network will begin to collapse on its own.

Additional: The target is not in the Carmel mining colony itself, but at a nearby military base. On paper, the base still belongs to its former owner, but RealWare corporate intelligence has confirmed that the facility was taken over long ago by Civil Resistance militants.
The base is prepared for defense and equipped with anti-spacecraft guns, among other things. For this reason, the shuttle carrying the operator will be deployed from a significant distance. The good news is that the colnodes are currently distracted by relocation preparations and should be unprepared for our arrival. The strike has to be fast. While Issachar is busy evacuating, we have a chance to decapitate the entire system with one precise hit.

Here are the keys. The data structure shows that <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chips</color> grant access to Issachar's central computer. But one is not enough. Standard entry into the system requires three keys. Our satellite scans show that all of them are on this level. Continue the sweep, recover the remaining chips, then head upstairs via the staircase.
Excellent, mercenary! Issachar's second key colnode is destroyed. Don't forget to pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color>. You'll need the full set for standard system access.
Excellent, good work. Grab the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> and head for the staircase to the second level. You now have the full set required to connect to Issachar's consciousness.

According to our estimates, resistance will be moderate. For you, however, even that is enough. Do not bring the <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color> close to the base, even if you want to use the geoscanner or count the signatures. Our spy satellite is operating nearby, we will provide you with all the necessary information. First of all, it is clear that destroying the server itself won't do any good. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> will simply transfer his consciousness to another part of the network. To eliminate him, you will have to enter the system and destroy his consciousness from the inside. Look for the access keys—without them, the operative clone will not be able to get inside.

Signal restored. We are detecting the collapse of the <color=#FFFEC1>Hellstrom Networks</color> across the Solar System. The operation can be considered a success. RealWare Security is now at combat readiness. Permission granted to evacuate the operator.

You don't even notice how willingly you go where you are led. Have you even tried asking questions? I placed the key in your hands only because I wanted to meet the mindless enforcer face to face. Come here and let's see what remains of you when I consume what you call a soul.

You are alone. Hear that? No voices on the comms, no orders, no kind capitalists behind your back. It is just you and me here. They threw you inside like a tool, and then left you to figure things out on your own. Let's see if you are capable of being something more than an instrument of someone else's will.

Do you really not understand who you serve? RealWare buys your ability to kill obediently, and you dutifully walk the line drawn for you by a soulless machine. We are not the network, mercenary. The network is them. A market of oppression, poisoning humanity. Turn back before it’s too late, or be destroyed.

There is a shortcut. Disable the anti-ship guns, and the pilots will be able to bring the <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color> to the base's docking airlock. From here I can connect to the central computer. I think one <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> will be quite enough for me.

Beyond this elevator is an airlock for docking heavy interplanetary ships. But as long as the base's anti-ship defenses are active, bringing the <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color> in is too dangerous. Disable the defenses first, and then you will be able to go up.

The pilots are already bringing the Magnum in to dock with the base. Take the elevator up to the docking airlock and make your way to the ship. A single Red Chip will be enough for you to access Issachar's computer.

Once all three Red Chips are inserted into the server, your consciousness will be projected into Issachar's hallucinatory-digital system. We are not sure if we will have contact with you in there. Your task will be to find Issachar's central psychological projection and destroy it. RealWare's combat AI is trying to hack the system and help you with virtual implants and weapons. We will do what we can. Good luck.

The Magnum has docked with the base, and we are already connected to the system. Now we only need the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color>. The ship's internal bulkheads are sealed — the colnodes shouldn't be able to get to us. Only the docking bay will be accessible to you.

Welcome back to the <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color>. Almost nothing has changed here since you flew out. All right, enough kidding around. Insert the <color=#FFFEC1>Red Chip</color> into the terminal, and we will try to project your consciousness inside <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar's</color> system. With the help of the RealWare combat AI, we have analyzed the hallucinatory digital reality deeply enough and will be able to help you with virtual implants and weapons. Your task will be to find the central psychological projection of Issachar and destroy it. Good luck.
Malleus Maleficarum
Enter the Civil Resistance central server.
You need to take the shuttle back to the Magnum. Evacuate as usual.

Boss, looks like someone else had a plan too. While we were coordinating the removal of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> leadership, <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> moved to seize every asset the pirates had been holding across the Solar System. <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> only got <color=#FFFEC1>Hargeysa</color>. Then again, it seems <color=#FFFEC1>Angus Dungeon</color> wanted it for some reason. Either way, the AnCap system just lost one major source of chaos.

We'll drop you on an old service level. According to RealWare’s intel, the pirates consider it a dead level and keep no guards there. Take a moment to look around and think through your approach. As soon as you move higher, they'll raise the alarm. The main elevator shaft runs through the entire station. The pirate admiral is on the fifth floor. Reach him and kill him.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the admiral of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color>.

Details: RealWare is launching a series of operations to save the AnCap system from total collapse. They have provided us with limited projections from their combat AI. While the machine searches for a way to destroy Tezctlan, we are to carry out preemptive strikes against the forces of the Civil Resistance and the Unchained Belt.
The Unchained Belt unites hundreds of pirate crews held together not by discipline, but by profit, mutual aid, and faith in what they call true anarchy. RealWare's combat AI proposes a simple move. If you destroy the coordinating center, the entire alliance will begin to fall apart on its own. That's it—no subtle politics, just a precise and brutal strike at the backbone holding the entire structure together.
We are not expecting unusual complications from this mission. On the contrary, surprise will be our greatest weapon. The Main Belt still has not realized that RealWare intends to act openly and decisively. The very act of breaking the old status quo is already working in our favor.

Additional: Hargeysa Station draws power from an old nuclear reactor. The reconnaissance data passed to us by RealWare indicates that it is stable, but caution may be required on the control level.

The facility managed to react to your arrival. The pirates have taken up pre-prepared defensive positions. Access to the fourth and fifth floors is blocked, but the admiral is still up there. You can force your way through by bypassing the security protocols. Reach the third floor—the control computer located there can be used to reprogram the elevator.
You have no business being here. This is a pirate vault, not the objective of the operation. Do not waste time and resources—return to the elevator and continue the mission.

Excellent. One of the most important commanders of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> has been eliminated. Operational skill bordering on genius. I will continue guiding you. Take the <color=#FFFEC1>Comm Key</color> off the corpse and insert it into the control computer by the elevator. That will open the way.

Enough. We are receiving analysis... The neurolinguistic report indicates that the target has lost the will to fight and is attempting to replace real defense with rhetoric. Resistance is broken. Proceed to the fifth floor and eliminate the admiral.

Proceed carefully. Failure at this stage is unacceptable. 50% of the operation is complete. The terminal keeping the fifth floor locked is on this level. It is a small information computer. Destroy it, and the path to the admiral will be open.
Loss of the valuable asset confirmed. Hargeysa has been destroyed. The outcome of the operation is unacceptable.

The admiral is dead, but our analytical satellite, connected to the station's systems, is detecting a critical change in the reactor's control loop. An artificial emergency scenario has been launched. An interesting move by the pirates—the trigger was linked to the admiral's heartbeat. Hargeysa is about to be destroyed in a nuclear explosion. New objective. You must not allow the loss of this asset. Find the control computer and destroy it—there is no time to reprogram it. There is very little time left before the reactor is destroyed, hurry.
The threat of reactor detonation has been eliminated. Operation completed successfully. Evacuation authorized.

Lost your way, clone? Without the <color=#FFFEC1>Comm Key</color>, there's no way you'll get into the control computer. And the key is with me. Come over here and take it off my corpse, if you can. Dead men don't bite.
You managed to crawl here after all, clone. The terminal is right here, next to me. I want to see how far you'll go before you drop dead.

Looks like they managed to wire an automatic lock into the loop. Magnum's sensors are detecting a new lockdown on the fifth floor. The control terminal is on the fourth level. One second... Yes, it's a small computer in one of the break rooms. Find it and open the path forward.

Hey, hey, salvage nation! Looks like we've got a parasite in the treasury. I'm authorizing part of the crew to leave their battle stations and go on a hunt. Who gets pulled off defense is to be decided strictly by drawing lots. I will personally pay a reward to whoever kills the clone.

All right, clone. Crawl your way up. I'm waiting. Just don't imagine you're climbing to yet another deck guarded by my overly humane friends. You're forcing your way into the place where the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> lives not by contracts, not by orders, and not by your fake little <color=#FFFEC1>dignitas</color> numbers on ship transponders. We live by rust, old seafaring spite, and iron that cuts your hands to the bone. That's why we die standing. Come on up. Just don't lose your shit.
This is where all this running around the floors ends. Welcome to my atomic deck. Now let's see if clones absorb lead as fast as food.

Boss, you should see this. The Hexarchs and the rest of the corporations are already farting out notes of protest across all channels. RealWare has subjected the surface of Venus to a massive nuclear-phase bombardment. Quasimorph activity is no longer being detected. Tezctlan has been destroyed—or, at any rate, securely cut off from the physical world. Most likely, the Feathered Masks perished with him.

RealWare requests that we await the next assignment. Something important is starting on Mars. Before retreating into another fit of madness, Eipschwitz managed to upload the technical documentation for the assembly of a Phase Bomb into the systems of the Magnum.

One minute to the designated landing point near the <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Temple</color>. Quasimorph sensors are blinded by powerful radiation, so we no longer have a reliable picture. The orbital satellite with the nuclear payload is also moving to the drop point. I hope you two meet soon. Receive the device, wait for the signal that it has dropped into the correct position, and await further instructions.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Ensure the safe landing of the atomic bomb at the <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Temple</color>.

Details: RealWare continues to restore order across the Solar System. The time has come to strike at the main source of disruption—Tezctlan. According to data from the RealWare combat AI, it is through the Feathered Temple on Venus that the Emerald Empire keeps most of the quasimorphs in the physical world, and Tezctlan himself is likely deep within the temple complex. Important! In violation of NCE norms, RealWare has authorized a nuclear strike on the temple's territory. However, conventional orbital bombardment would be ineffective. Structures phased in from Gannix are too resilient, and serious damage can only be dealt to the parts of the Temple located on the surface. Therefore, the payload will be delivered directly to the target. Our task is to receive it and ensure it is placed at a specific calculated point. A detonation there should trigger a chain of tectonic failures throughout the entire temple complex area.

Additional: The nuclear payload will be delivered from orbit in a locked state. The full arming key remains with RealWare command until delivery is confirmed. Once the payload is placed and confirmed by our operator, activation will be performed from orbit.

<color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color>, we are not interested in the nuclear payload. However, allowing <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> to acquire an effective anti-quasimorph weapon is unacceptable. They already have enough power to dictate terms to half the Solar System. Give them a way to reliably burn out bramfaturas, and very soon they will start deciding which worlds are worth saving and which are more useful when kept in fear. We cannot allow that.
Excellent. The payload is at the calculated point. Running a geoscan... One hundred percent confirmation. <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color>, say goodbye to the clone. I am activating the charge.
Activation complete. The operative has a brief window for evacuation. The mission is already considered a success. Whether the clone survives or burns with the Temple will not affect the outcome.

Spare me your moral arithmetic. <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color>, fight your way to the device and complete the installation of the phase detonator. Be advised: if necessary, I will activate the bomb without it.

Confirmed. It is <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color>. I imagine you will find it interesting to know that a few years ago, those bastards already stole one of <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color>'s nuclear payloads. Looks like they decided to try again. The objective remains unchanged. Fight your way to the bomb and install your detonator.

Do not rush to bury the king of the quasimorph realm, idiot. An ordinary blast—even a nuclear one—will solve nothing here. You will vitrify the surface for a while, and then those delightful creatures will come spilling back out of Gannix through telephaturic rifts. If you actually want to destroy a quasimorph instead of setting off fireworks, you need a phase detonator. And I can build one right here, out of local junk.

Now listen carefully. You cannot build a phase detonator out of sticks and stones. I need a proper workbench. The taltnoms who remain permanently in physical reality must have one somewhere. A workshop, a ritual forge, an altar bench—call it whatever you like, I do not care. Just find it. I assume there is no point looking outside. Carry me straight into the Temple.

All right, good. We made it. Now listen carefully and try not to confuse anything. You need to carry me to a workstation. I do not care what kind, as long as it has tools and usable metal. There is already more than enough of everything else down here.

And while we are at it, explain something to me. How did you people end up working for RealWare? Those idiots have been twisting and mangling the Solar System for so long it is a wonder it is still holding together. And now they think one especially powerful explosion will set everything right? Even if we do everything properly today, it will not cure quasimorphosis. At best, it will postpone the next breach. At worst, RealWare will simply push the world into a state where quasimorphs no longer have to force their way in. They will just leave the door open.

Wait, wait, wait. Here it is. This is enough. Use the workbench—you will be my hands. I will show <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> that <color=#FFFEC1>Dennett</color> wasted their dignitas on yet another quasibio-cryptogeoanalyzer. Everything I need is lying right here under our feet.

That is enough genius from me for one day. In front of you is a Phase Bomb. For our purposes, it will serve perfectly well as a detonator. Carry it back to the device and attach it. Now the nuclear blast will melt more than stone—it will strike at <color=#FFFEC1>Gannix</color> itself. You have no idea how badly I want to see what happens.

Be careful. Below lies a zone of severe phasic distortion. The outer surface of the Temple is still more or less anchored to <color=#FFFEC1>Venus</color>, but it is impossible to say for sure whether the temple itself is submerged in Gannix or already completely inside Venus. Expect fierce resistance.

Bad news, boss. An unidentified heavy interplanetary spacecraft has appeared in orbit. It's performing maneuvers typical of troop deployment. There's a high probability the enemy intends to intercept the object before the payload is activated.

RealWare has completed the redistribution of assets across the internal operational sectors of the AnCap system.

Pockets of destabilization that had prevented us from launching full-scale order-enforcement measures have been suppressed. Independent armed groups in the Main Belt have suffered unacceptable losses. Logistical risks have been reduced to tolerable levels. We can now address not the symptoms, but the cause.

According to the assessment of our combat AI, the primary source of the current disturbance is located on Venus. Tezctlan's activity can no longer be treated as a local anomaly. What we are dealing with is a hostile power center turning the region into a full-scale staging ground for further expansion.

There is new work for you. A strike will be carried out against the Feathered Temple on the surface of Venus. RealWare will handle the main body of the operation. You will be required to provide limited support through one of your operators.

You performed satisfactorily. The effectiveness of the phase bomb has been confirmed.

Do not expect us to keep clearing every obstacle for you in person. We currently have urgent business on Mars that requires a direct military response.

We are aware that the manufacturing instructions for the phase bomb are now stored in the systems of HIS Magnum. That is sufficient for your purposes, but insufficient for the next phase of the operation. We have transferred a container carrying a tactical nuclear device to your custody. Await further instructions.

And do not flatter yourself, mercenary. The nuclear device is locked. The full arming sequence and the authority to activate it remain exclusively with RealWare. You will deliver it where ordered. We will take care of the rest.
What is happening?!

What is going on down there, Magnum? Give me the feed from the hold... Ah. I see. Doctor Eipschwitz, I presume?

Angus, we will have to delay activation. If that head claims the payload can be made effective, we will proceed on the assumption that it can. Doctor Dennett warned me that Eipschwitz may be insane, but he is wrong less often than any of our instruments. Magnum, you have a new assignment. Send the doctor to the surface immediately. Let him modify the payload. I need a positive result, not just the explosion itself.

Let there be light!
Ensure the detonation of the RealWare atomic bomb.
